mapper.select: SELECT t.id,t.course_id,t.title,t.objective,t.status,t.version,c.status AS course_status,c.title AS course_title, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM market_attempt x WHERE x.task_id=t.id) AS locked, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_attempt x WHERE x.task_id=t.id AND x.student_id=#{user}) AS attempt_count FROM market_task t JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=t.course_id WHERE c.deleted=0 AND c.id=#{course} AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND t.status IN ('PUBLISHED','CLOSED') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_enrollment e WHERE e.course_id=c.id AND e.student_id=#{user} AND e.active=1) AND #{role}='mentor' AND c.mentor_id=#{user} ORDER BY t.id DESC
SELECT t.*,c.status AS course_status,c.title AS course_title FROM market_task t JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=t.course_id WHERE t.id=#{id} AND c.deleted=0
SELECT * FROM market_task WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM market_option WHERE task_id=#{id} ORDER BY position
mapper.update: UPDATE market_task SET title=#{title},objective=#{objective},situation=#{situation},question=#{question},reflection_prompt=#{reflectionPrompt},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE market_task SET status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_attempt WHERE task_id=#{id}
mapper.sql: a.*,o.label,o.outcome,o.explanation,NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM market_attempt older WHERE older.task_id=a.task_id AND older.student_id=a.student_id AND older.id<a.id) AS first_attempt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM market_attempt a JOIN market_option o ON o.id=a.option_id WHERE a.task_id=#{id} AND a.student_id=#{user} AND a.request_key=#{key}
SELECT FROM market_attempt a JOIN market_option o ON o.id=a.option_id WHERE a.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM market_attempt a JOIN market_option o ON o.id=a.option_id WHERE a.task_id=#{id} AND a.student_id=#{user} ORDER BY a.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE market_attempt SET reflection=#{reflection},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS studentId,u.user_name AS username,u.nick_name AS studentName, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_enrollment e WHERE e.course_id=t.course_id AND e.student_id=u.id AND e.active=1) AS enrolled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_attempt a WHERE a.task_id=t.id AND a.student_id=u.id) AS attemptCount, (SELECT o.label FROM market_attempt a JOIN market_option o ON o.id=a.option_id WHERE a.task_id=t.id AND a.student_id=u.id ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 1) AS firstChoice, (SELECT MAX(a.create_time) FROM market_attempt a WHERE a.task_id=t.id AND a.student_id=u.id) AS lastAttemptAt FROM market_task t JOIN sys_user u ON (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_enrollment e WHERE e.course_id=t.course_id AND e.student_id=u.id AND e.active=1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM market_attempt a WHERE a.task_id=t.id AND a.student_id=u.id)) WHERE t.id=#{id} ORDER BY u.id
